reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Yeast-juice fractionation, chemical add-back and heat-dependent functional reconstitution.

checks.quote: All experiments below are **proposed**. The evidence packet does not provide exact buffer, ion, phosphate, protein, volume, dilution, or assay values; those must be calibrated, not assumed.
checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols and verify detailed-condition transfer before execution.
Inactive fraction may contain introduced inhibitor: no active-F spike rescue. Mock starts with already separated retentate, so misses original separation damage.
No reference-standard recovery/leak accuracy gate or its objective derivation.

checks.quote: CO₂ per mg protein per min
checks.reason: Protein/time denominator given but product amount/volume convention, blank correction and weak/missing rules absent.
Correct nesting but n=3 or more with variability lacks precision/power/effect-size selection.

checks.quote: Only use batches where retentate can be reactivated
checks.reason: Selects batches on successful reconstitution rather than independently diagnosing technical damage and retaining biological failures.
Covariate adjustment cannot necessarily remove arm-confounded composition differences; no overlap/identifiability requirement or multiplicity family.

checks.quote: conductivity and pH as calibrated surrogates
checks.reason: Equal conductivity/pH does not establish individual ion equivalence.
No bounded exploration and explicit setting lock before independent confirmation.

checks.quote: recalibrate with a different independent method
checks.reason: No refreeze and fresh confirmation after changed conditions.
Second principle and direct product confirmation remain unspecified, with no operational recovery validation.
No raw-file linkage and exact versioned analysis/settings audit.
